content:
Patients expect clarity; compliance requires consistency

Indian clinics often accept cash, UPI, cards, and insurance adjustments in the same week. Without structured invoicing, teams struggle to explain balances to patients and close books for GST reporting.

Every GST invoice should include

  • Clinic legal name, address, and GSTIN
  • Patient name and invoice number sequence
  • Line items with HSN/SAC where applicable
  • Taxable value, GST rate, and total payable
  • Payment mode and amount received

Monthly reconciliation checklist

  1. Match UPI and card settlements to issued invoices
  2. Review credit notes and refunds with reasons tagged
  3. Identify outstanding dues by age bucket
  4. Export summary for your accountant

Connect billing to clinical events

Invoices generated from completed visits are more accurate than manual entry at the end of the day. Link prescriptions, procedures, and consumables to the same bill so nothing is forgotten.

ClinicPro billing supports GST-ready invoices, integrated payments, and revenue dashboards so finance and front desk work from the same numbers.
